citation: Weibezahn and Kendziorski (2019). Illustrating the Benefits of Openness: A Large-Scale Spatial Economic Dispatch Model Using the Julia Language. Energies 12, 1153. https://doi.org/10.3390/en12061153
description: Joulia.jl is a Julia model of large-scale spatial electricity dispatch. The repository provides the model code and points to a separate JouliaExamples repository for an example instance. Inputs are generators, transmission links, regional demand and operating costs; outputs are economic-dispatch and power-flow decisions for the configured electricity system. Geographic scope and hourly or other temporal detail are determined by the supplied instance. The code is free under MIT terms. A limitation is that the main README is sparse, so a new user needs the example repository and the cited methods article for data layout and assumptions. Dispatch results also depend on network and cost inputs, and the README does not claim operational grid validation. Joulia can support electricity-transmission and market-planning studies. PyPSA (model-pypsa) is a related open-source system model. The example was identified through the maintainer's link but not run or downloaded.
name: Joulia spatial electricity dispatch model
